jobs.description_html:
Every search represents someone seeking reliable information. They depend on search results being accurate, trustworthy, and relevant to their local context. But search engines only learn to return trustworthy information if human evaluators with deep research expertise and cultural knowledge verify and correct them. Your linguistic precision, fact-checking rigor, and understanding of how your culture communicates and values information is irreplaceable in building search systems that people can actually trust.

 

In this role, you will evaluate search queries, results, and AI-generated content for factual accuracy, authority, relevance, and user intent alignment. Your judgment determines whether search systems return trustworthy, contextually appropriate information.

 

  • Analyze multi-turn search queries and web results for factual accuracy, source authority, and user intent alignment
  • Conduct cross-referencing and fact-checking using regional sources, specialized databases, academic resources, and web directories
  • Assess localized content relevancy across diverse domains—news, sports, local culture, technical queries considering regional context and cultural nuance
  • Evaluate AI-generated content for factual grounding, hallucination risk, and contextual appropriateness
  • Provide structured assessments that train search ranking and content relevance models

 

Qualifications to succeed in this project:

 

  • Professional fluency in English
  • Residency in the United States for the last 3 consecutive years  
  • Active use of Gmail and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content
  • Deep local cultural awareness and familiarity with regional news, current events, and contemporary culture
  • Strong fact-checking and critical thinking abilities
  • Access to a stable broadband internet, a reliable computer and a smartphone (Android 5.0, iOS 14 or higher)
  • Linguists, cross-cultural researchers, domain specialists, and detail-driven professionals with strong research methodology (preferred)

 

Why join the project:

 

  • Fully remote flexibility: Structure your contributions around research, consulting, teaching, or other professional commitments without rigid scheduling
  • Comprehensive research support: Access detailed evaluation guidelines, reference materials, databases, and resources for fact-checking across domains
  • Quality recognition: Performance assessments focused on consistency, fact-checking precision, and nuanced judgment
  • Intellectually demanding by design: If you are driven by fact-checking precision, source authority analysis, and the challenge of identifying what makes information truly trustworthy, this work is built for that mindset.
  • Responsive support: Direct access to evaluation support staff for clarification on ambiguous queries or technical guidance
  Qualification path

How to get started:

  • Complete your contributor profile and application
  • Take a qualification assessment at your own pace within the time given
  • Verify your identity through our secure identity verification process
  • Acceptance form & Rater Academy: Complete an acceptance form and approximately 2.5 hours of Rater Academy training
  • Receive your project assignment and access credentials

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is 0.2333 USD per task, with an estimated earning potential of 14 USD per hour.

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes.   • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Back-End

Front-End

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.

What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently

  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. Role Overview:

  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount.

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

What we’re looking for

  • Strong proficiency in React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS for production workloads.

  • Solid understanding of web security best practices (OWASP, secure storage, encryption in transit/at rest, secrets management).

  • Experience building systems in or adjacent to healthcare, education, or compliance-heavy environments is a plus.

  • Excellent async communication, code ownership, and ability to work with a small, senior-led team.

  • Comfort working from a clear product brief and also proposing improvements proactively.

  • Familiarity with logging, monitoring, and observability tools.

Take-home assignment (Step 1 of the process)

Please complete a take-home assignment. You are allowed to use LLMs to write code. To ensure that your work will not be used at Fluence, we’ve made it unrelated to healthcare:

Build “LendLoop”: a neighborhood tool-lending board with automated workflows

A simple app where neighbors list tools they are willing to lend, request to borrow from each other, and receive automated notifications and reminders handled by n8n.

Stack

  • Next.js (App Router)

  • Clerk for authentication

  • Convex for data + backend logic

  • n8n (self-hosted via Docker or n8n Cloud) for workflow automation

  • TypeScript

Requirements

Public page

  • The fictional company name is LendLoop.

  • Short tagline, e.g. “Borrow what you need. Lend what you don’t.”

  • Show:

  • A “Sign in to lend or borrow” button wired to Clerk.

Authenticated experience

  • Only signed-in users can:

  • List a tool with:

  • name

  • category (power tools, garden, kitchen, camping, etc.)

  • condition

  • short description

  • Request to borrow a tool for a date range.

  • Approve or decline requests on their own tools.

  • Mark a loan as returned.

  • Show:

  • All tools with availability status, filterable by category.

  • “My listings”, “My requests”, and “Incoming requests” views.

  • Nice, minimal layout.

Roles & rules

  • admin:

  • user:

    • Can create, edit, and delete only their own listings, and act only on requests involving their own tools or their own borrowing.

  • Implement the above role-based access control with best practices, enforced in Convex functions, not only in the UI.

Über Buena

Buena (backed by GV) macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Ob Suchen, Kaufen oder Finanzieren einer Wohnung. Wir tun das, indem wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland übernehmen und in Technologieunternehmen verwandeln. In den vergangenen drei Jahren sind wir mit weniger als 25 Vollzeitmitarbeitern im HQ zur zweitgrößten Hausverwaltung Deutschlands geworden.

Über die Rolle

Drei Prozent Prozessoptimierung nach vier Wochen Freigabeschleife – oder ab Tag eins die Schlüssel zu sechs Unternehmen, zweistelligem Millionenumsatz und einem 25-Milliarden-Euro-Markt?

Als Regional Operations Manager übernimmst du unsere größte Wachstumsregion. Du bringst unsere bestehenden Hausverwaltungen vor Ort auf Zielmarge und baust die operative Struktur, mit der wir jeden weiteren Zukauf sofort zu integrieren und skalieren.

Dein Platz ist im Berliner HQ, Tür an Tür mit Jan (COO), den Gründern und unserem Tech-Team – gleichzeitig bist du regelmäßig in NRW an den Standorten, um Dinge direkt im Raum zu klären. Volle Verantwortung für die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung deiner Region, ohne Umwege.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Du trägst die volle operative Verantwortung für Umsatz, Kosten und Ergebnisentwicklung deiner Region.

  • Du schärfst unser Betriebsmodell mit dem Integrationsteam und skalierst es auf alle bestehenden und neuen Standorte.

  • Du löst operative Engpässe vor Ort und bringst unsere Standorte auf Zielmarge.

  • Du bringst ungefiltertes Feedback direkt in unser Berliner Tech-Team, damit unsere Software manuelle Arbeit vor Ort ersetzt.

  • Du baust die Abläufe deiner Region so auf, dass die Standorte sauber laufen und wir mühelos weitere Firmen integrieren können.

Du passt, wenn du

  • Mehrjährige operative Erfahrung in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mitbringst (z. B. Operations, BizOps, Founders Associate oder Regional Manager).

  • Zahlen sofort durchdringst und direkt ins Handeln kommst, statt Folien zu bauen.

  • Schon einmal einen Bereich von Grund auf aufgebaut, vergrößert oder operativ gedreht hast.

  • Verantwortung übernimmst, pragmatisch nach Lösungen suchst und schwierige Gespräche klar führst.

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau sprichst.

Deine Benefits.

  • Unternehmerische Verantwortung für sechs Standorte ab Tag eins und der Auftrag, unseren größten Markt aufzubauen.

  • Starkes Fixgehalt plus virtuelle Anteile (VSOP) an einem der am schnellsten wachsenden Tech-Unternehmen Europas.

  • Fester Platz im Berliner HQ direkt bei Jan (COO), den Gründern und unserem Tech-Team.

  • 110 € Lunch-Budget, 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss, täglich Frühstück, guter Kaffee im Office und 1.200 € Weiterbildungsbudget im Jahr.

Warum jetzt einsteigen

  • Du bist die Schlüsselperson vor Ort, denn mit über 90.000 Einheiten und mehr als 30 übernommenen Verwaltungen wachsen wir rasant – und jede neue Firma wird erst durch dich zu einem echten Buena-Betrieb.

  • Bei uns zählt, was du lieferst, nicht dein Titel: Unser CEO war vor drei Jahren Junior Product Manager, unser COO vor zwei Jahren Chief of Staff.

  • Du bewegst etwas Greifbares, weil die deutsche Hausverwaltung vielerorts noch auf Papier und Excel läuft und wir sie gemeinsam auf moderne Technologie umstellen.

📍 Berlin | Bezirk Lichtenberg | 2 Tage Home Office

💻 Microsoft 365 | Azure | Automatisierung | Digitalisierung

Du möchtest als zentrale IT Ansprechperson die technische Infrastruktur eines Unternehmens gestalten, weiterentwickeln und automatisieren?

Unser Kunde ist ein dynamisch wachsendes E Commerce Unternehmen in Berlin, das mit tausenden Produkten in verschiedenen Kategorien erfolgreich auf digitalen Marktplätzen agiert. Als einer der führenden Händler auf Amazon in Deutschland verbindet das Unternehmen datengetriebene Prozesse mit einem modernen Technologieansatz.

Für die interne IT wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die als fachlich führende IT Person die Microsoft Umgebung verantwortet, technologische Standards setzt und gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Geschäftsprozesse automatisiert.

Deine Benefits

Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.

Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.

Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.

Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.

Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.

Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.

Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.

Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.

Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits.

Deine Aufgaben

Als fachlich führende IT Person verantwortest du die gesamte interne IT Umgebung. Da die Infrastruktur bewusst schlank gehalten ist und der Support überschaubar bleibt, liegt dein Fokus vor allem auf Architektur, Sicherheit, Automatisierung und der Weiterentwicklung der IT.

Microsoft 365: Vollständige Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint und Teams einschließlich Conditional Access und Geräte Compliance.

Azure: Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Azure Umgebung mit Fokus auf virtuelle Maschinen, Netzwerk, Backup und Kostenoptimierung.

Netzwerk & Security: Verantwortung für Netzwerk, Sophos Firewall und VPN sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen und sicheren Betriebs.

Automatisierung: Konzeption und Umsetzung von Geschäftsprozess Automatisierungen mit Power Automate und PowerShell in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen.

Technologie & Standards: Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter Technologien, Definition technischer Standards sowie strukturierte Dokumentation der IT Umgebung.

IT Projekte: Eigenständige Steuerung von IT Projekten sowie Koordination und fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister bei Bedarf.

3rd Level Support: Fachliche Unterstützung der Junior Kollegin, die den 1st und 2nd Level Support übernimmt, sowie Übernahme komplexer technischer Fragestellungen im 3rd Level.

Wissensaufbau: Fachliche Weiterentwicklung der Junior Kollegin sowie Vermittlung von Wissen und Best Practices innerhalb des Unternehmens.

KI & Digitalisierung: Weiterentwicklung des strukturellen Einsatzes von KI Lösungen und Automatisierungstechnologien zur Optimierung interner Prozesse.

Prozessoptimierung: Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse, Identifikation von Digitalisierungspotenzialen und Entwicklung nachhaltiger technischer Lösungen.

Rund 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Systemadministration oder als Systems Engineer.

Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Entra ID, Intune und der Microsoft 365 Administration, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, dieses Wissen weiterzugeben.

Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, insbesondere mit virtuellen Maschinen, Netzwerken und Backups.

Erfahrung mit Netzwerken und Firewalls, idealerweise mit Sophos.

Sicherer Umgang mit PowerShell im Arbeitsalltag.

Erfahrung mit Power Automate oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich in diesem Bereich weiterzuentwickeln.

Ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis und der Anspruch, Prozesse zunächst zu verstehen und anschließend sinnvoll zu automatisieren.

Eigenständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und Kolleginnen und Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gutes technisches Englisch.

jobs.description_html:
Bei CloudFactory sind wir ein missionsgetriebenes Team mit der Leidenschaft, das Potenzial von KI zu erschließen, um die Welt zu verändern. Durch die Kombination fortschrittlicher Technologie mit einem globalen Netzwerk talentierter Menschen machen wir bisher nicht nutzbare Daten nutzbar und erzielen damit echten Impact in großem Maßstab.

Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz – wir sind eine globale Gemeinschaft, die auf starken Beziehungen und der Überzeugung basiert, dass sinnstiftende Arbeit Leben verändert. Unser Engagement für Earning, Learning und Serving treibt alles an, was wir tun. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine Million Menschen mit sinnstiftender Arbeit zu verbinden und Führungspersönlichkeiten aufzubauen, denen man gerne folgt.

Unsere Kultur

Bei CloudFactory glauben wir daran, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle ermächtigt, wertgeschätzt und inspiriert fühlen, ihr authentisches Ich einzubringen. Wir sind:

  • Missionsgetrieben: Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, wirtschaftlichen und sozialen Impact zu schaffen.
  • Menschenzentriert: Wachstum, Wohlbefinden und das Zugehörigkeitsgefühl unseres Teams liegen uns sehr am Herzen.
  • Innovativ: Wir nehmen Veränderungen an und finden gemeinsam bessere Wege, Dinge umzusetzen.
  • Global vernetzt: Wir fördern die Zusammenarbeit über verschiedene Kulturen und Perspektiven hinweg.

Wenn Sie sich für Innovation, Zusammenarbeit und echten Impact begeistern, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie an Bord zu begrüßen!

Rollenübersicht

Als Site Reliability Engineer spielen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle dabei, alle Produktionssysteme reibungslos am Laufen zu halten. Sie arbeiten eng mit anderen Engineers und Operators zusammen, um Engineering-Prinzipien, Betriebswissen, Sicherheit und Automatisierung zu verbinden – mit dem Ziel von Production Excellence auf Plattform- und Service-Ebene aus Sicht von Infrastruktur, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit.

Das SRE-Team verantwortet das Fundament der Core-Plattform unserer AI Platform – die Services und Infrastruktur, die uns Deployments über verschiedene Public-Cloud-Anbieter hinweg ermöglichen und viele ML- und LLM-gestützte Funktionen antreiben. Wir geben jedem anderen Engineering-Team eine zuverlässige Basis, auf der es aufbauen kann, und wir verantworten den Software-Delivery-Lifecycle Ende-zu-Ende: das Tooling, die Patterns und die Automatisierung, die Reibungsverluste für das gesamte Unternehmen reduzieren.

Dies ist eine spannende Gelegenheit, sich beruflich weiterzuentwickeln und gleichzeitig zu einer missionsgetriebenen Organisation beizutragen.

Aufgabenbereiche: Was Sie verantworten

  • Zuverlässigkeit der Plattform (einschließlich ML- und LLM-Workloads) – Infrastruktur für Model-Serving und Inferenz (GPU-gestützte Endpoints, Autoscaling, Latenz- und Kosten-Trade-offs), mit SLOs, Bereitschaftsdienst (On-Call) und Incident Response, die nicht nur Services, sondern auch Modelle abdecken
  • Observability (einschließlich ML-Modellen) – Drift- und Performance-Monitoring für ML sowie LLM-spezifisches Tracing, Evals und Guardrails, angebunden an dieselben Metrik- und Logging-Stacks, die wir überall sonst einsetzen
  • Unternehmensweite technische Ausrichtung: Mitgestaltung der Roadmap und Aufbau von Golden Paths, die den Standard für jedes Team anheben
  • Developer-Tooling und Automatisierung, die sich multipliziert – wiederverwendbare GitHub Actions, GitOps-Workflows, Terraform-Module –, damit alle Engineers schneller ausliefern
  • Wiederverwendbare Komponenten, die gängige Open-Source-Tools (Grafana, Istio, Cloud-Native-Stack sowie ML-Tools wie Model Registries und Feature Stores) bündeln, damit Teams sie in jeder Umgebung deployen können
  • Secure-by-Default-Infrastruktur – Verankerung von Sicherheit, Compliance-Audits, Kosten-Governance und Audit-Trails in der Plattform in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Lead-, Backend- und Staff-Engineers.

Vergütung

Die anfängliche Vergütung für diese Position beträgt 55.140 € brutto pro Jahr. Konkrete Angebote werden anhand von Aufgabenbereich, Qualifikation und Erfahrung festgelegt.

Requirements

Wer Sie sind (Must-haves)

  • 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Infrastructure Engineering, DevOps oder SRE im Betrieb groß angelegter, hochverfügbarer Produktionssysteme mit Kubernetes
  • Operative Produktionserfahrung – ein Live-Cluster unter echter Last, kein Labor. Fundierte Kenntnisse in Helm sowie Terraform oder CloudFormation auf mindestens einem großen Cloud-Anbieter (AWS bevorzugt).
  • Gute Kenntnisse in Python oder Go oder allgemeinem Scripting für Automatisierung und Tooling (Automatisierung mit einer höheren Programmiersprache bevorzugt)
  • KI ist bereits Teil Ihres täglichen Loops – Agentic Tooling (Claude Code, Codex, Droid, interne Skills) gehört zu Ihrer Art auszuliefern und ist nichts, womit Sie nur experimentieren. Wir glauben, dass KI-Tools mit menschlichem Urteilsvermögen großartig sein können, und wir möchten, dass das SRE-Team die nächste Welle in den täglichen Betrieb bringt.

jobs.description_html:
At Parallel Domain, we believe that autonomous systems – from self-driving cars to contactless delivery drones – have the opportunity to drastically improve the quality of life for billions of people. That is why we love what we do: enabling our customers to develop their technology safely using the Parallel Domain data generation platform. Our platform revolutionizes the way our customers generate sensor data for AI development. We're looking for people like you to join us in pushing the boundaries of artificial intelligence and synthetic data.

About the role 

Before any physical AI system is trusted in the real world, it has to prove itself in ours. Parallel Domain turns real captured drives into faithful digital replicas — geometry, appearance and motion that perception stacks are trained and validated against.   We are hiring a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to push our feed-forward reconstruction stack forward — from static 3D toward full 4D scenes over time. You will join a small, deep team where your technical judgment carries real weight from day one, and your work will ship in a pipeline customers depend on.
What You'll Do
  • Advance our feed-forward reconstruction models. Improve how we predict geometry, camera pose and appearance from real capture with transformer-based models, and extend it from static scenes to dynamic 4D.
  • Train at scale. Run multi-node GPU training on large multi-view and video datasets, and decide what to scale, what to ablate and when a result is real.
  • Define what "good" means. Build evaluation the team trusts for reconstruction quality, temporal consistency and geometric accuracy.
  • Explore stronger priors. Investigate where generative models, such as pre-trained video diffusion, can help fill gaps the capture did not see.
  • Land research in the product. Work with the pipeline engineers to get results into production, and care whether they hold up there.
  • Track the field. This area moves monthly; form a view on where it is heading and argue for it.

    • What we're looking for
  • Hands-on feed-forward reconstruction experience. You have built or trained feedforward 3D reconstruction models (for example in the lineage of DUSt3R, VGGT, π³ or D4RT), and you know where they work and where they break.
  • A track record of models others relied on. We weight demonstrated depth over years served : a recent PhD with the right focus and an experienced research engineer are both credible here.
  • Large-scale training. Practical experience with multi-node, multi-GPU training and telling a promising run from a stalled one early.
  • Strong PyTorch skills in a large shared codebase with real build and CI.
  • Research judgment. You turn an ambiguous direction into experiments that resolve something, and change your mind when the numbers say so.
  • Clear communication with researchers, pipeline engineers and leadership alike.

    • Strong pluses
    These are listed in order of how much they matter to us.  
    1. Feed-forward Gaussian prediction. Experience predicting 3D Gaussians directly from images in a single pass, rather than fitting them per scene. 
    2. Top-tier publications in feed-forward reconstruction. First-author or significant work at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR or SIGGRAPH in this area. 
    3. Video diffusion models. Familiarity with diffusion or flow-matching video models, especially camera-conditioned generation. 
    4. Dynamic scenes. Work on dynamic reconstruction, scene flow or temporal consistency. 
    5. Real-world capture. Experience with automotive, robotics or drone data and its mess: imperfect calibration, motion blur, poses you cannot trust. 
    6. Making big models fast, or open-source contributions to widely used reconstruction libraries.
    Why join Parallel Domain?
    We are assembling a team of creative, talented visionaries seeking to build a new technology that will change the world. You will be able to learn, build, and scale our team and technology in a collaborative, creative culture that values every team member.

We are committed to providing employees with an environment free of discrimination, bullying and harassment. At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

The Community Programs team creates the spaces, programs, and opportunities that help our community thrive. We're looking for a Community Engagement and Advocacy Manager to help us strengthen relationships with the people who use, build with, and advocate for Tailscale.

In this role, you'll own and grow three important areas of our community: the Tailscale Insiders advocacy program, our digital communities, specifically Discord and Reddit, and our Community Projects program.

You'll focus on creating meaningful opportunities for community members to connect, contribute, share their expertise, and be recognized for the work they do. Whether that's helping an Insider find their next speaking opportunity, bringing Tailscale staff into conversations on Discord, or showcasing an exciting community-built project, you'll help turn community participation into lasting relationships and advocacy.

You'll work closely with teams across Tailscale, including Developer Relations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Support, to connect community members with the right people, resources, and opportunities.

We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys working with people, understands what makes communities thrive, and can turn ideas into thoughtful, well-run programs. You don't need to be deeply technical, but you should be curious about technology and excited to learn from the people building with it.

Key Responsibilities

Insiders Advocacy Program

  • Own the strategy, day-to-day operations, engagement, and ongoing growth of the Tailscale Insiders advocacy program.
  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with Insiders, understanding their interests, expertise, motivations, and how they want to participate in the Tailscale community.
  • Develop recurring engagement opportunities that help Insiders connect with one another and with teams across Tailscale.
  • Identify opportunities for Insiders to contribute through speaking engagements, technical content, community events, product feedback, testing, and other initiatives.
  • Partner with internal teams to create clear pathways for Insiders to participate in company initiatives, ensuring opportunities are relevant and mutually beneficial.
  • Identify and nurture emerging advocates across the Tailscale community, creating pathways for deeper participation and potential involvement in the Insiders program.
  • Own the recruitment, onboarding, recognition, and ongoing engagement of Insiders, ensuring participants feel valued, supported, and connected.
  • Gather feedback from program members and continuously improve the Insider experience.
  • Track program participation, contributions, engagement, and outcomes to understand and communicate the impact of the program.

Digital Communities: Discord & Reddit

  • Own the strategy, day-to-day engagement, and overall community experience across Tailscale's Discord and Reddit communities, fostering welcoming, active, and inclusive spaces.
  • Develop and execute engagement initiatives, including community events, AMAs, discussions, and member spotlights that encourage participation and connection.
  • Partner with teams across Tailscale to bring staff into community conversations and create opportunities for meaningful engagement.
  • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Developer Relations to plan and lead Discord and Reddit engagement around product launches, announcements, and key company initiatives.
  • Own day-to-day community moderation, including enforcing guidelines, managing moderation tools and bots, coordinating volunteer moderators, and escalating sensitive issues to appropriate internal teams.
  • Identify opportunities to improve community engagement, structures, and experiences based on member feedback and participation.
  • Recognize and celebrate active members and contributors, creating opportunities for deeper involvement and advocacy.
  • Monitor community conversations, feedback, and engagement metrics to identify emerging themes, share actionable insights with internal teams, and inform community strategy, product decisions, and program improvements.

Community Projects

  • Own the strategy, operations, and continued growth of Tailscale's Community Projects program, recognizing and amplifying projects built by our community.
  • Develop and maintain a clear, repeatable process for discovering, submitting, reviewing, tracking, and showcasing community projects.
  • Build relationships with project creators, understanding what they've built, their motivations, and how Tailscale can support and recognize their work.
  • Partner with Developer Relations, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to identify opportunities to turn community projects into technical content, demos, documentation, social content, and community showcases.
  • Create opportunities for project creators to share their work through community events, presentations, blog posts, videos, and other channels.
  • Identify projects that demonstrate creative or emerging uses of Tailscale and help surface those examples to relevant internal teams.
  • Develop thoughtful ways to recognize and reward contributors, ensuring builders receive visibility and credit for their work.
  • Track program activity, project contributions, and outcomes to help demonstrate how community projects support advocacy, learning, and broader awareness of Tailscale as a platform.

What We Are Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of experience in community management, advocacy, community programs, developer communities, or related roles.
  • Experience owning and growing community programs, including developing initiatives, coordinating stakeholders, and driving engagement.
  • Proven ability to build meaningful relationships with community members, advocates, contributors, and internal teams.
  • Experience managing and moderating online communities, including community guidelines, moderation tools, and maintaining healthy, inclusive environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage authentically and collaborate across teams.
  • Excellent organizational and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and navigate ambiguity.
  • Strong understanding of community engagement and advocacy, with the ability to identify opportunities, recognize contributors, and turn feedback into meaningful improvements.
  • Genuine curiosity about technology and an eagerness to learn about Tailscale's products and community.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing advocacy, ambassador, champion, or contributor recognition programs.
  • Hands-on experience managing Discord, Reddit, or similar community platforms, including moderation bots and automation tools.
  • Experience working with developers, open source, infrastructure, networking, security, or other technology-focused communities.
  • Familiarity with community engagement and intelligence tools such as Common Room.
  • Experience developing community programming such as AMAs, virtual events, member spotlights, and recurring engagement initiatives.
  • Experience identifying and amplifying community stories, projects, or contributor achievements.
  • Experience collaborating with Product, Developer Relations, Engineering, Marketing, or Support teams.
  • Willingness and ability to travel occasionally to support community events, meetups, and other initiatives.

About AppOmni

AppOmni is redefining SaaS security for the age of agentic security operations. As AI transforms the way security teams build, operate, and defend their environments, AppOmni is pioneering a new approach to securing the world’s most critical SaaS ecosystems.

From its roots as a leader in SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM), AppOmni is driving the next evolution of SaaS security - bringing intelligence, automation, and agentic capabilities into security operations. AppOmni empowers organizations to move beyond traditional visibility and posture management toward more intelligent, proactive, and autonomous security.

Recognized as a Frost Radar™ 2025 Leader and Great Place To Work®, AppOmni continues to set the standard for innovation and customer value in SaaS security.

About the Role

This position in a rapidly growing security engineering company is an opportunity to own the architecture that lets the largest regulated enterprises adopt AppOmni. Our customers' security teams review our platform as closely as we review their SaaS applications, and they expect fine-grained access control, control over their encryption keys, least-privilege access to the SaaS applications we monitor, and a network and identity architecture they can trust.

As a Senior Architect, you will define how the AppOmni SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) platform meets those requirements across the application, identity and network layers. You will work with engineering teams to deliver it, and you will represent the architecture directly to customer security and architecture teams. These are hard problems in a multi-tenant platform, and your decisions will shape how the product is built for years.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture for AppOmni's enterprise readiness capabilities and maintain a roadmap for them with Product.
  • Design role-based access control for the platform, including custom roles, permissions scoped by SaaS application or business unit, and consistent enforcement across the UI, APIs and integrations.
  • Design bring-your-own-key and customer-managed key support on Google Cloud KMS, extending our existing per-tenant envelope encryption, including key rotation, revocation and the effect on data availability.
  • Define the OAuth and API access model for monitored SaaS applications, minimizing the permissions and scopes we request from each vendor, and work with SaaS vendors where their permission models fall short.
  • Own identity integration requirements: SAML and OIDC single sign-on, SCIM provisioning, service accounts and API tokens, and session management.
  • Be the authority on our network architecture on Google Cloud, including VPC design, private connectivity options, egress controls and static IPs for customer allowlisting, ingress protection, and service-to-service authentication in GKE.
  • Strengthen tenant isolation and data protection across the platform, and review new services for security and enterprise readiness before they ship.
  • Join customer architecture and security reviews, answer technical due diligence, and turn recurring customer requirements into platform features.
  • Write architecture documents and reference designs, and mentor engineers on secure design.

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years in software engineering, security engineering or architecture, including 4+ years as an architect or principal-level engineer on a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Deep experience designing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC or relationship-based models) for enterprise products.
  • Hands-on experience with encryption and key management in the cloud, including envelope encryption, KMS, and customer-managed or externally held keys.
  • Strong knowledge of OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM from both the identity provider and the application side.
  • Strong cloud network security experience: VPC architecture, private connectivity, firewalls, egress control, TLS and mTLS, and zero-trust service access, ideally on Google Cloud.
  • Experience taking a SaaS product through enterprise security reviews and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001 or FedRAMP.
  • Ability to read and write production code in Python or Go and review designs down to the code level.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with engineers, executives and customer security teams.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

You Might Also Have

  • Experience with Kubernetes and GKE security, including workload identity, network policies and service mesh.
  • Experience with policy engines such as OPA or Cedar, or Zanzibar-style authorization services such as SpiceDB.
  • Experience with the admin and permission models of enterprise SaaS platforms such as Salesforce, Microsoft 365, ServiceNow or Workday.
  • Experience serving financial services or other highly regulated customers, including data residency requirements.
  • A background in identity security (IAM, ITDR) or SaaS security products.
  • Experience securing AI agent access to data and APIs.


What Success Looks Like
First 90 days: Review the current platform architecture for access control, encryption, identity and networking, and produce a gap assessment against the requirements our largest customers raise. Publish an enterprise readiness architecture plan agreed with Product and engineering leads. Join customer security reviews and own the technical responses.


The Technology You'll Work With

  • Google Cloud Platform: GKE, Cloud KMS, VPC, Cloud SQL, Spanner, Pub/Sub, BigQuery
  • Python (Django, FastAPI) and Go
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse
  • Kubernetes, Nginx and Terraform
  • OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML and SCIM


Culture

Our talented team is collaborative and supportive as we move quickly to research and develop new ideas, deliver new features to our customers, and iterate on ideas and innovations. We accomplish this by focusing on our five core values: Trust, Transparency, Quality, Customer Focus, and Delivery. Our team is determined to make a difference to positively impact our way of life by securing the technology that is changing the world.

AppOmni is proud to be Certified by Great Place to WorkⓇ, as we seek to build a culture where all employees feel appreciated and supported, especially with clear and honest leadership, employee recognition, and an environment that fosters innovation and collaboration.

We believe diversity fuels innovation and drives growth by bringing a wealth of different perspectives and skills. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee feels valued, heard, and empowered to reach their full potential. Join us in building a workplace where we can all thrive.

Compensation & Benefits

AppOmni is committed to supporting our employees' financial, professional, and personal well-being. To do this, we take a holistic view of compensation, one that values not just the immediate financial package but also the long-term growth of both our employees and our company. We're committed to pay equity and transparency and encourage all candidates to discuss their salary expectations with us early in the application process.

Our total rewards package includes the following:

  • Base Salary: The annual base salary compensation range in the U.S. for this role is: $200,000 - $300,000 USD. Final offer amounts are determined by factors such as the final candidate’s location, skills, qualifications, and experience, as well as business considerations and peer compensation.
  • Stock Options: Our vision is to not just grow as a company but to grow together. By offering stock options, we are inviting you to be an integral part of our journey forward.
  • Benefits: Generous paid time off, paid company holidays, paid floating holidays, paid parental leave, paid sick time and paid family leave for applicable states, health insurance - medical, dental, and vision with HSA option, LifeWorks Employee Assistance Program, company-provided life insurance, AD&D, STD/LTD and additional supplemental life insurance options, 401(k) and Roth retirement saving accounts, and a monthly wellness benefit reimbursement. All benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and plan details.

Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, medical condition, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Overview

CoinTracker is on a mission to unlock everyone's financial potential so they can build the life they want. We started with crypto, building the tax and portfolio tools that millions of users trust to trade digital assets with peace of mind. Nino builds the next layer of financial fluency for our users. Nino is an AI-powered financial operating system that makes comprehensive, expert-level tax and financial planning advice accessible.

More on Nino: Comprehensive tax and financial planning strategies are currently locked behind high AUM fees or require enough wealth to have a family office. We are turning expert judgment into software so we can serve millions. AI is going to redefine how people understand their finances and how tax advice gets delivered. Not in ten years, in 2026. You can help define that, or spend the next few years adapting to rules someone else wrote. Nino sits inside CoinTracker ($100M raised, partnered with Coinbase, TurboTax, H&R Block, and Thomson Reuters) with the autonomy of an early-stage startup and the reach of an established platform.

Your mission

As Tax Lead, you'll own a book of roughly 50 Nino clients end-to-end: preparing, reviewing, and filing their returns and giving them proactive, white-glove tax advice.

Most of your time goes to client and compliance work, using our in-house AI tools alongside traditional tax software.

Along the way, you'll share what you learn with our engineers, so the logic in your head (ISO exercises, AMT crossover points, multi-state allocation, Roth conversions) makes our AI smarter for every household after yours. Product experience is a plus.

When we're done, the tax planning advice we'll provide won't just be static advice delivered once a quarter. It will execute, perform, and action personalized advice to each customer in a way that is simply not possible with legacy tax planning.

Location: U.S. remote.

Your one-year outcomes

  • Manage 50 to 60 clients end-to-end with excellence.

What you will do

  • Interface with Clients: Proactive tax insights and white-glove experience.

  • Prepare, review, and file tax returns for households (starting with those in $1M – $25M net worth) plus related business returns.

  • Share your tax logic: relay learnings from client work so engineers can turn your reasoning into product.

  • Review AI output: check and correct AI-generated advice before it reaches your clients.

  • Solve Edge Cases: AMT crossover, wash sales, multi-state allocation, QSBS, pass-through optimization.

What we look for

  • Role-agnostic

    • Opportunity alignment: You want to bring expert tax and financial advice to households that have outgrown doing it themselves, and you want to do it at an early-stage company where your work moves the number.

    • High agency: You see what needs doing and do it. You don't wait for a brief, a budget, or an engineer.

    • Exceptional collaboration: You make the people around you better: sales, advisors, engineers, and agencies. You say what you think and follow through.

    • First-principles thinking: You start from how customers decide, not from a playbook. You can explain why a number moved.

  • Role-specific

    • 5+ years with an active CPA license. You've prepared, reviewed, and/or filed 500+ individual (1040) returns.

    • You've served clients with $1M – $25M net worth.

    • You have working knowledge of business returns (S-corps, partnerships, Schedule C, LLC).

    • You know the tax code, not just the tax software. You research ambiguous positions using primary sources (IRC, Treasury Regs, Rev. Rulings, case law) and can defend them.

    • You're AI native, with hands-on use of AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT.

    • Bonus: you're a tax attorney or CFP, or you have experience with trusts and estate planning.

The starting salary for this position is between $137,000 - $162,000 USD. Candidate's location does not impact the posted salary range.

The actual compensation offered will be based on a variety of job-related factors including relevant skills, education, and experience. This position also includes equity in CoinTracker and benefits like medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life insurance, and PTO.

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

We’re seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer to join our growing team. You will work as part of the engineering team to:

  • Deliver projects related to pricing plans and billing
  • Develop our billing integration with third party services, strengthening our end-to-end billing experience.
  • Take ownership of the entire product lifecycle, from writing code to product ideation and strategic decision-making.
  • Work closely with UX/UI designers and product managers to shape features.

Because we’re an early-stage and fully remote company, we’re looking for a strongly motivated individual who can help move the product forward. The ability to think on your feet, collaborate with highly technical teams, and comfort working asynchronously are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work as part of a team of engineers to design, build, test, and document core billing software components.
  • Integrate with third-party billing platforms (e.g., Stripe, Metronome) as needed
  • Develop metering, pricing, and rating logic for usage-based and subscription billing models.
  • Ensure accurate tracking and reporting of customer usage data.
  • Monitor and maintain billing systems to ensure high availability and data integrity.
  • Build automation tools for recurring billing tasks, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with product, sales, and finance teams to support custom billing requirements.
  • Work closely with finance, product, support, and engineering teams to support accurate billing, revenue reporting, and customer inquiries.
  • Act as a technical expert in billing-related discussions and planning.
  • Champion engineering excellence by driving code quality, architectural reviews, and design documentation.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other engineers, fostering a culture of learning and knowledge sharing.
  • Establish observability, alerting, and error handling across the billing pipeline to ensure high availability and responsiveness.
  • Lead incident response and root cause analysis for billing-related issues.

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience in backend software engineering, with a strong focus on billing, payments, or financial systems.
  • Deep knowledge of SaaS billing models, including subscriptions, usage-based pricing, proration, discounts, and entitlements.
  • Proven experience integrating with third-party billing platforms such as Stripe, Metronome, Orb, Zuora, etc, or building custom billing systems.
  • Experience designing and managing distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.
  • Proficient with SQL and data modeling, especially for financial and usage data.
  • Solid understanding of APIs and experience building or integrating internal billing APIs.
  • Strong proficiency in Go, or comfortable writing production-quality code in another language and eager to work with Go
  • Flexibility to adjust to the dynamic nature of a startup.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

$143,000—$179,000 USD

  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!

Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.

The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack.
